summary: 36-year-old hiker missing while hiking/camping near Lake Isabelle found dead Monday evening; body recovered Tuesday from remote rocky terrain
location: Indian Peaks Wilderness near Lake Isabelle/Shoshoni Peak
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office Emergency Services, dog teams, helicopter
